tasks.title: Solid fill with the theme fill color
tasks.note:
REJECTED
- hpq/tests/SolidFillTest.cpp: SketchFilledRectHasHandDrawnOutline still passes when no outline is drawn. Checked on a scratch copy where `if (m_has_pen)` in draw_hand_drawn was changed to `if (false && m_has_pen)`: all 6 SolidFill tests passed. Cause: outline_is_covered_by_ink accepts any pixel for which is_ink_blend is true, and the Sketch fill #D0D0D0 lies between #FFFFFF and #333333 so it counts as ink blend; fill pixels next to the edge cover every outline point, and "differs from plain QPainter" also passes on a rough fill alone. -> Make the check need real ink on the outline: for each outline point, require a pixel within D that is darker than the theme fill, or that is neither background nor fill. Also check that the pixels between the inner rect (D+1 inside) and the outer band (D outside) are not all fill or background. Then confirm the test fails when the stroke is removed.
